To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the ASTRI SST-02M prototype is a small-size telescope with a primary and secondary mirrors of 4 meters in diameter, made of 19 and 7 segments respectively, that are assembled on an electro-mechanically driven structure.

the ASTRI SST- 2M prototype has a 4m diameter and a 3m focal length, it is a double mirror optical system, it is based on an innovative electro-mechanical structure and the primary mirror consists of 37 hexagonal segments.

the ASTRI SST- 2M prototype is the first telescope with a Schwarzschild Couder optical configuration and it has been developed to test the optical and electro-mechanic performances of a telescope that will be part of the CTA observatory.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following topics: - the mechanical design of the SST-2M prototype; - the mechanical and optical characterization of the prototype primary mirror segments; - the development of the optical alignment procedure.
the development of the ASTRI SST- 2M prototype and the study of the mirror technology for the primary and secondary mirrors of the telescope.
the development of a new generation of Cherenkov telescopes for the CTA project.

, after the successful development of the first prototype, we are now able to proceed with the development and the realization of the full scale primary mirror.
the ASTRI SST- 2M prototype is a fully functional telescope with the capability to perform a complete observation cycle from target acquisition to the data taking.
the ASTRI SST- 2M prototype, which is the first telescope with a Schwarzschild- Couder configuration, is a successful and promising project.

the design and the development of the telescope and of the mirrors have been completed, and the prototype of the primary mirror segments have been produced and are now under testing.
the telescope is now in a phase where it has been fully assembled, aligned and tested in the laboratory.
the design and the construction of the ASTRI prototype have demonstrated that the Schwarzschild-Coudé configuration can be implemented with a high degree of accuracy.

the design of the telescope is fully compatible with the requirements of the CTA observatory.
the telescope design and the mirrors are fully compatible with the CTA requirements and that they can be produced and assembled within the ASTRI project schedule.
